assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create a literary science-fiction novel cover for the finished story All at Once. Portrait 9:16, compose for final 864 x 1536 crop with important content and all title lettering well inside the central safe area. Render the exact title 'All at Once' ONCE, clearly readable, as part of the painting, understated large ivory serif lettering in the upper open sky; no author name, no subtitle, no other words. A worldwide birth of supernatural powers during one catastrophic day: depict one actual epic moment, an enormous mountainous piece of a modern island has risen into the air, with an ordinary city of closely packed low-rise houses riding on its broad top. Show a convincingly immense suspended rock underside and a clear gap of open air between it and the land below. A tiny modern island airfield runway crosses the foreground. Several long ropes hang from reachable low edges of the floating land down to solid ground, with very small ordinary human figures climbing and gathering; the geography must make those ropes believable, not kilometer-long ropes or giant people. One slope remains low enough for access; far taller rock and houses loom beyond. A sliver of coastal sea establishes the island. Buildings are contemporary, no castles, no spaceship, no giant psychic, no superhero costume, no mind-control apparatus. The land is levitated, not exploding: awe and danger in the weight overhead, and stubborn human activity below. No gore. Canadian Group of Seven inspired OIL painting: broad rhythmic value and color masses, varied directional opaque brushstrokes, selective substantial impasto on lit rock and clouds, quieter connecting passages and connected dark shadow beneath the rock with lost edges. Natural pale cloud-filtered light, restrained green-black rock, ochre earth, grey-violet coast and soft ivory sky, without automatic orange-blue contrast. Painterly simplified architecture and tiny human figures, material oil texture, NOT glossy photorealism, cinematic rim light, uniformly beveled mosaic facets or a collage of power icons. Compose a memorable book cover with large shapes and generous breathing room around the title.

assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create a landscape 1536 x 1024 location reference OIL painting for the story All at Once. It shows the floating island mountainside with a modern city on its back, an actual location in the finished prose. No text. View from near a modest modern island airfield: small people on the runway and adjacent solid land look up at a vast suspended mountainous section of the island, dark exposed rock underside clearly separated from the ground by a broad airy shadow gap. Modest contemporary low-rise houses and winding streets ride on its top, trees and city intact but precarious; no fantasy castles, sci-fi towers or spaceship. A lower projecting edge is near enough to the ground that several long ropes can connect the suspended land to reachable solid ground. Make the attachment at the TOP of each rope visible, give ropes gravity-true curves, and show very small ordinary people climbing at different heights and a small group waiting at their feet; some travel up, some down. The airfield, floating city, island coast and human scale should be understandable as one coherent place; the sea only in a distant coastal strip, no docks, floodworks or water infrastructure. The power comes from an unseen trapped woman below the houses; do not invent a giant glowing figure driving it. Non-graphic catastrophe, a remarkable inhabited mass overhead and tiny human choices beneath it. Canadian Group of Seven inspired painting: broad rhythmic colour/value masses, varied directional opaque strokes, selective thick paint on lit stone and cloud, quieter unbroken passages, connected deep violet-green shadow under the island and lost edges, simplified architecture. Natural filtered late-day daylight, pale quiet sky, muted earth and forest colours, no glossy digital faces/lenses, no cinematic rim lighting or uniform beveled facets. This is a location painting rather than an illustrated map or a montage.
Keep access improvised: hanging ropes only, no walking footbridge, planked path, staircase, or solid bridge linking the floating land to the ground.
